verdict.rationale: Alacritty's GitHub README says it uses vtebench to measure terminal throughput and consistently scores better than competitors. Hands-on community reports back this up: a find benchmark ran 0:20 vs 1:28 in iTerm2, rendering kept up with fast-scrolling tmux log panes, and Ctrl-C stayed responsive after accidentally catting a 1GB file or binary output because refresh is locked to the screen rate. One user finds foot faster, which is a comparison rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: no evidence in the pack explicitly documents GPU/OpenGL acceleration as the rendering mechanism, and no first-party detail on responsiveness under heavy output beyond the throughput benchmark claim.
